description: This file models hardware timers, system tick, real-time clock, and related timing functionalities for the native_posix platform in Zephyr OS. It includes functions for timer initialization, configuration, and time management, with support for real-time synchronization and debugging.

methods.name: us_time_to_str
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit microsecond time value into a formatted string hh:mm:ss.ssssss for debugging.

methods.name: get_host_us_time
methods.description: Returns current host time in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_real_time_mode
methods.description: Sets whether the timer operates in real-time mode.

methods.name: hwtimer_update_timer
methods.description: Updates the combined timer value based on tick and awake timers.

methods.name: host_clock_gettime
methods.description: Retrieves current host clock time.

methods.name: hwtimer_init
methods.description: Initializes the hardware timer model, setting start times and offsets.

methods.name: hwtimer_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up timer resources (empty implementation).

methods.name: hwtimer_enable
methods.description: Enables hardware timer tick interrupts with specified period.

methods.name: hwtimer_tick_timer_reached
methods.description: Handles the event when the tick timer reaches its scheduled time, including real-time synchronization.

methods.name: hwtimer_awake_timer_reached
methods.description: Handles the event when the awake timer reaches its scheduled time.

methods.name: hwtimer_timer_reached
methods.description: Checks and handles timer events when timers reach their scheduled times.

methods.name: hwtimer_wake_in_time
methods.description: Requests the hardware timer to wake the CPU at a specific future time.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_silent_ticks
methods.description: Sets the number of silent (skipped) timer ticks.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_pending_silent_ticks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending silent ticks.

methods.name: hwtimer_reset_rtc
methods.description: Resets the real-time clock offset to zero.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_rtc_offset
methods.description: Sets the RTC offset in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_rt_ratio
methods.description: Sets the ratio of simulated time to real host time.

methods.name: hwtimer_adjust_rtc_offset
methods.description: Adjusts the RTC offset by a delta.

methods.name: hwtimer_adjust_rt_ratio
methods.description: Adjusts the ratio of simulated to real time by a correction factor.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_simu_rtc_time
methods.description: Returns the current simulated RTC time in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_pseudohost_rtc_time
methods.description: Returns a host time that accounts for drift and ratio, as if the host clock had been running from the native_posix clock.

methods.name: native_add_time_options
methods.description: Adds command-line options for time configuration and control.
